🚨THE ANGRY BIRDS MOVIE 3 IS COMING! 🚨 Catch the newest adventure on the big screen — see it ONLY in theaters on December 23rd!

WELCOME TO ANGRY BIRDS TOWER DEFENSE! 
The Pigs are launching an all-out multiverse invasion of Bird Island! Deploy your favorite bird units, unlock devastating upgrades, and defend your eggs from King Pig's army. Do you have what it takes to save Bird Island?

🕹️ GAME FEATURES:
🦜 Unique Bird Towers: Red (Single-Target DPS), Chuck (Piercing Speed), Bomb (AOE Splash), Terence (Heavy Boss Breaker), and Stella (Knockback/Support)
🌌 The Angryverse: Your favorite characters from across the “Angryverse” with nods to Angry Birds Epic, all 3 Angry Birds Movies, Angry Birds Toons and more
🐷 Challenging Pig Waves
🗺️ Dynamic Maps: Defend through South Beach! Cornucopia Woods and Bird Village COMING SOON!
🏆 Multiple Game Modes
🔄 Merging and Upgrading

🐣 Free UGC!
